newsitem.title: USA: NYS Mortgage Agency plans $110 mln bond sale.
newsitem.headline: NYS Mortgage Agency plans $110 mln bond sale.

text.p: The New York State Mortgage Agency plans an approximately $110 million sale of refunding and new money bonds on June 17 through a syndicate led by Lehman Brothers, an agency official said on Thursday.
While the final size of the sale has yet to be fixed, Charles Rosenwald said that he expected about $66 million of refunding bonds to be sold, along with $44 million or so of new money bonds.
The agency also is planning addtional sales this summer, but they have yet to be set.
"I can't tell you when yet, we're not that far ahead in our planning," he said."
